author: William Blake
title: Songs of Innocence and Songs of Experience
edition: London: R. Brimley Johnson; Guildford: A. C. Curtis, 1901. Only Songs of Innocence is selected. Project Gutenberg transcription of this dated printing. Paragraph line wrapping and HTML spacing are normalized; verse line and stanza boundaries are retained. Image-only initial letters are restored from their source alt text and joined to the following word. Page numbers, images, illustration captions, and publisher/digitizer matter are omitted. The library text holds the whole book, Songs of Innocence and Songs of Experience: the book title, then each part title as a level-1 heading and each poem title as a level-2 heading, with stanza lines stripped of their display indentation; the title page, imprint, contents and illustrations are omitted.

rights.basis: This original English edition was published in 1901, before 1931; its US publication copyright term has expired as of 2026. No modern introduction or illustrations are included.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg HTML (pg1934-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror) parsed with Python's html.parser: the PG header, footer and licence removed; the title-page byline and imprint, the contents table and every illustration image dropped. The three-line title heading became one level-1 heading, with its small-capitals “and” written in capitals; the part titles SONGS OF INNOCENCE and SONGS OF EXPERIENCE became level-1 headings and the 47 poem titles level-2 headings. Each poem paragraph became one stanza, its HTML line breaks kept as lines and each line's leading indentation removed. Typographic quotation marks, dashes and accents kept as transcribed. Every Grade 3 night from this book was located block for block.
